description: Come make a difference in a fast-growing, innovative, Software Product Management team that combines a scale-up atmosphere with a global industry-leading product portfolio. You’ll be part of building the future of Trackunit’s connected ecosystem - helping shape products that connect people, data, and machines to build a smarter construction industry. At Trackunit, we put our customers first. As a Product Manager, you’ll work across teams and departments to guide software products from research and idea through to launch - connecting the customer, technical, and business worlds. You’ll break down complex problems into clear, actionable steps and drive product development with focus, purpose, and measurable outcomes. This is a new product area at Trackunit, focused on the person who runs the job site day to day, coordinating equipment, safety and crew productivity on the ground. We're early in this space and building from a first concrete starting point, but the ambition is broader, understanding and solving the daily challenges this persona faces on site. It's a chance to shape a product area from the ground up, starting close to a real customer problem. As Product Manager for this area, you will own the roadmap and priorities that help managers run a smoother, safer job site day to day. You will work closely with Engineering, Design and Go to Market teams to turn a broad and still evolving problem space into real product value for our customers. We’re looking for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, brings clarity amid change, and builds strong alignment across diverse teams. If you’re passionate about creating meaningful products and want to make a tangible impact in a global SaaS company - we’d love to hear from you. You will be connected to one of our offices in Europe or North America with the possibility to work from one of the dedicated offices and remotely in a flexible capacity. For this position, you need to be based in Europe or in the Eastern time zone in North America. Please note that we do not offer relocation assistance for this position. If you have questions about eligibility based on your location, feel free to reach out and we will clarify this during the process. What’s in it for you? You'll join the Contractor Pod, the team focused on solving the daily challenges construction companies face on their job sites. This role sits within a green field initiative, one of the newest and least defined spaces in the pod, giving you the rare chance to shape a product area from its earliest days rather than inherit an existing roadmap. A place in a hyper-growth SaaS business, with possibilities to grow internally in the company. We are moving quickly, so fasten your seat belt and prepare to adjust. Back in 2020 we were 150 employees at Trackunit and we have just passed 450 employees. International environment with regular check-ins and social events across teams, departments and borders. We take your personal and professional development goals seriously and we support them through training, coaching and mindfulness as well as with an open feedback culture to enable you to identify your strengths and opportunities. We do this by touching upon your impact on our triple focus: impacting yourself, impacting teams/relations and impacting the organisation/strategy. Flexibility and hybrid working is not just a cliché to us or something we state in a job posting. We do offer you a flexible setup and believe that you best can structure how your routines look like. And once you have chosen how you work best, let us know what you need: we got you covered with the IT equipment you need for your work. Turning the Tide. At Trackunit, we aim to create and contribute to an inclusive workplace. And this priority starts with our hiring - we do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity, sexual orientation, personal expression, ethnicity, religious belief, or disability status. We only assess candidates on their qualifications and merit. Learn more about TIDE and other DE&I initiatives here. Who are you ideally? You're comfortable in your product management craft and have experience taking a product from zero to one, defining scope and direction in an ambiguous space rather than executing against an already defined roadmap. You're skilled at getting close to users through direct discovery, including field based research, and can translate what you learn from users into a clear product direction. Big plus if you've built products for frontline, non desk based users, and know how to design for someone who is on the move, at a job site, rather than sitting at a computer. You think and build AI-first. You reach for AI capabilities as a default design tool - not a bolt-on -and you know how to evaluate when AI genuinely reduces friction versus when it adds noise. You’ve shipped or closely partnered on AI-powered product features, and you can have a substantive conversation with engineers about what’s feasible, what’s not, and what’s worth the bet. You bring great structuring and analytical skills with the ability to implement strategic product plans and to proactively make things happen with a hands-on attitude. You're an effective communicator who knows how to work asynchronously and across time zones. You’re experienced in the full product lifecycle: from backlog refinement and sprint execution to coordinating with go-to-market teams. You’re adept at navigating trade-offs, bringing cross-functional clarity, and moving work forward. You bring commercial awareness and know how to define and measure progress with data and feedback loops. You’re collaborative and pragmatic. Comfortable aligning when you can, and pushing forward when you can’t. You focus on delivering impact, not just output, and you own what you build. Don't meet every single requirement? No worries - this is what we're looking for ideally, but if you're super excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. Primary Responsibilities Own the direction for this new product area: Define what gets built and why, as we grow from an early starting point into a product that supports site managers and foremen running the job site day to day. Drive end-to-end product execution: Own the build process from backlog refinement to release, working closely with Engineering and Design to deliver high-quality outcomes. Lead go-to-market efforts: Coordinate with Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to ensure launches are aligned, well-orchestrated, and supported by clear enablement. Create clarity across functions: Align teams on scope, trade-offs, and timelines, especially where regional context, dependencies, or ambiguity exist. Build effective async collaboration: Communicate clearly across time zones and stakeholders, using structured, proactive updates to keep momentum. Shape how we work: Contribute to evolving product practices, frameworks, and rituals, rather than just following what exists. Our hiring process Don't waste your time on writing the best possible cover letter for the job. We want you to create an impact that matters, and that's not in the cover letter. Virtual meet and greet. Meet Malin Lindbom, Director of Product Management and the hiring manager for this role. Assignment-specific interview. We want you to get an insight into some of the concrete work tasks or projects related to the role. You will be given a case to prepare prior to the interview, and at the interview, you will present the case to relevant colleagues from across Trackunit, who you’ll also work closely with in the job. If needed, throughout the process we will obtain references from former employers and do background checks for level specific, if you have not provided these yourself. Offer presentation and walk-through. We’re lucky to have you! Coming Together To Connect Construction We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale. We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products – it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues get together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do it to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world. The question is: Are you in?
title: Product Manager - Contractor Pod

description: Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title And Summary Specialist, Product Management - AI Overview: In virtually every country worldwide, Micro, Small, and Medium Businesses (SMEs) are the lifeblood of economic vitality. Mastercard is dedicated to enabling businesses to survive and thrive stronger than before. Our rallying cry is Empowering Every Business Everywhere. This segment is central to Mastercard’s growth strategy - not only because of their global impact but also because of SMEs’ significant role in the payment ecosystem as both payers and acceptors of electronic payments. We are seeking a Specialist (Product Management – AI) to support the strategy, development, and commercialization of AI-powered products within our platform. This role will support the product lifecycle for intelligent agentic solutions, translating complex data, AI/ML capabilities, and partner ecosystems into scalable, high-impact customer-experiences. You will be working closely with senior product leaders, engineering teams, and cross-functional stakeholders. Responsibilities: Support the delivery of one or more product features or problem areas within AI-powered solutions, aligned to the broader product roadmap Translate product requirements into well-defined EPICs, user stories, and acceptance criteria for engineering and data teams Support the development of LLM-powered and agentic AI features, including conversational experiences and workflow automation Partner with engineering, design, and data science teams to execute on roadmap commitments, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery Collaborate on product discovery activities, including user research, hypothesis validation, and experimentation Support the product development process, helping to manage scope, priorities, and project timelines. Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences. Qualifications: Experience working in Product Management, product development, business analysis, consulting, or a related technology-focused role Working knowledge of AI concepts such as LLMs, RAG, agentic workflows, and evaluation frameworks Demonstrated ability to translate product requirements into execution-ready deliverables Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to think outside the box. Excellent teamwork skills with an ability to get the work done with minimal supervision. Advanced degree in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, or related field is highly desirable. Experience contributing to the development and delivery of digital products or technology solutions Globally distributed teams in India, EU and US. Some travel may be required. Additional Information: This role is hybrid, with the expectation of working in the Dublin office at least 3 days per week. Corporate Security Responsibility All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

description: As the Product Manager for Search & Discovery, you will own the end-to-end shopping flow of the Suitsupply webstore — spanning navigation, homepage, search, product listing pages, and product detail pages — with funnel conversion and add-to-bag rate as your north star. You will collaborate with a small AI-native squad of engineers and AI agents within the Commerce Platform domain, driving outcomes through sharp prioritization and hands-on collaboration rather than coordination overhead. By combining behavioral data, qualitative insight, and AI-driven analysis, you will shape how millions of customers across 25+ countries discover and engage with our products. This is a high-impact individual contributor role where your strategic decisions directly influence the shopping experience, revenue performance, and the future of AI-native product development at Suitsupply. What You Will Do Own the end-to-end shopping flow — menu, homepage, search, PLP, and PDP — and drive funnel conversion as your primary outcome metric. Define and track product KPIs; translate insights into a prioritized, outcome-led roadmap that keeps the team focused on impact. Shape search and personalization capabilities by evaluating and rolling out tooling that powers a smarter, more relevant shopping experience. Run discovery across the customer journey using behavioral data, qualitative research, and AI-driven analysis to surface opportunities. Translate customer needs into clear, actionable requirements for engineers and AI agents — spanning UI/UX, search relevance, merchandising logic, and PDP. Work at the frontier of AI-native product development: train and improve AI agents through feedback loops, manage the skills they use, and partner with engineering to move ideas from prompt to pull request. Partner closely with Growth, Merchandising, Marketing, and Design to align the shopping experience with broader business objectives. Who You Are 2–4 years of product management experience in e-commerce or retail, with a demonstrated track record of improving conversion funnels or shopping flows; Shopify experience is a plus. Strong eye for UX/UI; experience with search or personalization products is a strong preference. Data fluent — comfortable working in BigQuery, Looker, or Mixpanel to validate hypotheses and measure impact. AI-native mindset: you already use tools like Claude or Cursor daily and actively push the boundaries of what AI can do for a product team. Outcome-oriented and self-directed; you drive results through clear thinking and sharp prioritization, not through process overhead. Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field. What You Will Get Autonomy: We empower you to take ownership, make meaningful decisions, and drive impact without layers of sign-off. Growth: We see your potential as a key asset. At Suitsupply, you'll have abundant opportunities to learn, grow, and excel in a supportive environment that encourages development at every step. Corporate Social Responsibility: Our commitment to sustainability and ethical business is unwavering. We work exclusively with suppliers who uphold the highest standards, in alignment with the International Labour Organization. Style: Immerse yourself in a world of beautifully crafted, high-quality products, and enjoy a 40% discount on Suitsupply products. Compensation: We offer a competitive salary of €68,000–€88,000 annually, based on relevant skills and experience.

description: At home24, we believe everyone deserves a home they love. But before raw customer data can turn into personalized recommendations and seamless experiences across our webshop, CRM, and marketing channels, we need someone behind the scenes to make the magic happen. This is where you come in: As our Product Owner Customer Data, Audiencing & Activation (m/f/d) , you’ll combine your analytical mindset, data stewardship passion, and product vision to own our 360-degree customer profile, build high-value audience segments, and bridge the gap between engineering and commercial teams. Do you enjoy bringing customer data to life, driving activation ROI, and actively shaping process efficiency and data governance? Then join us and help us create even more Happy Homes! Your Responsibilities Own the Unified Customer Profile: Act as the owner of our 360-degree customer view. Decide what data enters the platform and how it is modeled into a single, trusted source of truth. Manage Data Collection & Governance: Define tracking requirements (events and attributes) for the customer journey, while ensuring our data models respect user consent and GDPR guidelines. Champion Data Trust & Governance: Act as the functional Data Steward. Define schema designs, naming standards, and data dictionaries, ensuring our data practices respect user consent and GDPR guidelines. Bridge the Gap to Engineering: Translate complex use cases and business needs into structured technical requirements and user stories for our Data Engineering and Analytics teams. Architect Audiences & Predictive Layers: Define and manage global, reusable customer traits and advanced audience segments (e.g., RFM, propensity, and CLV) to ensure they are easily accessible across all channels. Drive Activation & Business Impact: Partner closely with Growth Marketing, CRM, Webshop, and Customer Service to run personalization experiments, activate segments, and directly measure data ROI. Guide Tooling Decisions: Evaluate and shape our data infrastructure for customer data. Your profile You have successfully completed studies in data/analytics, computer science, business informatics, economics, or a comparable field. You bring at least 3 years of hands-on experience managing data products, data infrastructure, or analytics platforms, ideally with exposure to consumer data in an E-commerce or digital product environment. You possess a strong understanding of customer data infrastructure, including event tracking, identity resolution, data modeling, and audience orchestration. You genuinely enjoy the "data stewardship" aspect of the role—building clean, intuitive schemas and data dictionaries that make customer data easily digestible and self-serve for business users. You have strong SQL skills and are comfortable querying data warehouses, independently auditing data quality, and validating audience segment sizes without needing engineering help. You bring a product-oriented mindset and act as a natural "translator"; you easily gather unstructured business needs, break down complex data constraints for commercial teams, and ruthlessly prioritize an engineering backlog based on ROI. You are proficient in English; additional knowledge of German is considered a plus. What We Offer You Your impact The chance to make an impact in a highly motivated team of professionals An open-minded culture ready to incorporate new and creative ideas Your growth Extensive learning opportunities from our home24 academy and external partners Room for growth and development within your role through regular feedback rounds Your path Hybrid working model: you have the flexibility to work from home on Wednesdays and Fridays in our standard working mode. We are in the office together Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays The possibility to work up to two months per year within Germany or from an EU country The opportunity to take up to 30 days paid vacation each year to unwind and recharge City mobility with a subsidized public transportation ticket and our eco-friendly bike leasing program #ridinghome Your second home International campus in the heart of Berlin featuring drive-in bicycle garage, outdoor space and lounge areas, fitness facilities, parent and multi-faith rooms close to the Berlin S-Bahn train station Landsberger Allee Company benefits including a pension scheme, 30% off the home24 assortment, and employee discounts at partner organizations You want to learn more about our home24 company culture and what it is like to be a Homie? Follow @teamhome24 on Instagram If you are interested in being a part of an exciting success story, get in touch. The same is true for home24 as an employer. We celebrate the diversity of the people who work with us. Be who you are and feel welcome to #makeyourselfathome24 You can find all job offers on our career site ! home24 SE | Otto-Ostrowski-Straße 3 | 10249 Berlin | Contact: Cornelia Wegner We are home24, one of the leading home & living e-commerce platforms in continental Europe. We are currently active in seven countries. Over 1,000 Homies work together towards a common goal: to create happy homes for everyone and every budget. How can we reach this goal? With an assortment of over 250,000 pieces of furniture and accessories from more than 1,000 suppliers, we offer the perfect addition to any living space combined with the comfort of being able to shop from anywhere. What makes us proud to be Homies? We are pioneers in our market who seamlessly combine technology and creativity. We utilize data to provide personalized recommendations, tips and inspiration for every home. At home24, we strive to deliver a superior assortment of products and the best service. To do this, we need fresh ideas, 100% motivation, and dedication to our company mission. We always have a space at our table for service-minded individuals who are passionate about digitization and modern living.

description: At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. This position reports to: Chapter Leader Product Management __ Your Role And Responsibilities In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape ABB's next generation of UPS offerings by working at the intersection of product management, market intelligence, and customer success. Each day, you will collaborate with global stakeholders, agile teams, and customers to ensure our product portfolio remains competitive, customer-focused, and aligned with business objectives. You will also showcase your expertise by translating market needs into technical solutions and supporting the successful launch and adoption of new offerings. The work model for the role is: Hybrid. This role is contributing to the Smart Power Division, Electrification Business Area. Main stakeholders include Product Management, R&D, Sales, Operations, Service teams, and customers across global markets. You will be mainly accountable for: Driving cross-functional collaboration by acting as the key interface between agile teams, global functions, and customers to translate market and customer requirements into clear product specifications and customer-centric solutions. Managing the product lifecycle of assigned UPS products, supporting business case development, cost reduction initiatives, and ensuring technical solutions are effectively leveraged across the portfolio. Conducting market and competitor analysis through market sizing, trend monitoring, and benchmarking activities to identify product gaps and support portfolio strategy and roadmap decisions. Supporting go-to-market and sales enablement activities by developing communication materials, supporting new product launches, providing product training, and participating in customer engagements. Our team dynamics You will join a high-performing, cross-functional Agile team that thrives on collaboration, speed, and innovation, where quality is non-negotiable and sustainability is embedded in every stage of the product development process. Qualifications For The Role You are highly skilled in Agile methodologies and product management practices. You have at least 2 years of experience in product management, including stakeholder management and collaboration with global functions such as Sales, Operations, Service, and R&D. You have experience working with product lifecycle management processes and stage-gate development models. You possess knowledge of PLM tools, SAP, and the Microsoft Office Suite. Experience with cost modeling and competitor benchmarking is considered an advantage. You are passionate about collaboration, customer-centric thinking, and driving innovation through cross-functional teamwork. You hold a degree in Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or an equivalent field. You are at ease communicating in English. You are flexible regarding working hours and willing to travel internationally when required. What's in it for you? Opportunity to shape ABB's next-generation mid- and low-power UPS portfolio with global impact. Work in a dynamic, innovation-driven environment with strong sustainability commitments. Access to career development programs, global mobility opportunities, and cutting-edge technology projects. Collaborate with global experts and contribute to innovative solutions that support customers around the world. Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences. Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

In this role, you will work closely with internal business partners, IT, analytics, operations, and vendor teams to create alignment, support decision-making, and help deliver platform capabilities. You will translate organizational needs, process requirements, and business priorities into clear product plans, well-prioritized roadmaps, and successful platform-enabled solutions. This role is well suited to someone who can balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution, build alignment across internal and vendor stakeholders, and keep the end-user and business outcomes at the center of decisions. About Movado B.V. One of the world’s premier watchmakers, our client designs, sources and distributes multiple brands in the Watch and Jewelry segments worldwide. What You’ll Do Support the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and priorities for the vendor platform and the business capabilities it enables. Translate business goals, user needs, process requirements, and stakeholder input into clear product requirements, vendor briefs, timelines, and launch plans. Maintain a prioritized backlog of platform enhancements, configuration needs, integrations, and issue-resolution priorities, balancing business value, user impact, technical feasibility, vendor constraints, and timelines. Coordinate inputs, decisions, dependencies, and deliverables across internal teams and vendor counterparts to move platform enhancements and fixes from discovery through configuration, development, testing, launch, measurement, and continuous improvement. Prepare clear product briefs, requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, launch updates, and decision materials that help teams understand scope, trade-offs, risks, and next steps. Contribute to product management best practices, stronger intake and prioritization routines, and more consistent ways of working across teams. Stay curious about business processes, vendor platform functionality, retail trends, digital tools, and emerging technologies that may improve platform experience or ways of working. Build trusted relationships across teams, regions, and vendor partners through clear communication, accountability, and inclusive collaboration. About You Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; other European languages are a plus. 3-5 years’ experience in product management, platform product management (Pepperi, Mirakl), business systems, digital product, operations technology, ERP integrations or a closely related role. Experience managing a technology platform, including roadmap planning, user stories, testing, and release planning. Experience partnering with technology, systems, or vendor teams to deliver enhancements, resolve issues, and support rollouts. Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage priorities, timelines, dependencies, and stakeholders. Comfortable using data, reporting, user feedback, and business metrics to inform recommendations and measure outcomes. Detail-oriented, organized, and able to move work forward in a fast-paced environment. Collaborative working style and skilled in building relationships across teams and regions. What We Offer 8% holiday allowance on top of your base salary. 5% pension contribution (shared employer/employee). Hybrid working (3 days in office). 25 vacation days plus public holidays. Employee discount. Long term Service Awards. Movado Group, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. It prohibits discrimination based on age, color, disability, marital or parental status, national origin, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status or any other legally protected status in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws.

description: The role We are seeking a motivated and analytical individual to join Qogita’s Supply Growth team. This role sits at the intersection of growth, automations, and customer success - supporting our most valuable and operationally complex suppliers. You will help automate supply growth and ensure operational excellence by managing and improving workflows to identify, prospect, and qualify B2B leads. This role offers hands-on exposure to enterprise-grade go-to-market operations in a fast growing B2B marketplace. What You'll Do As a B2B Growth Associate your goal is to build automations which help identify and qualify high-potential suppliers, fuelling our rapid expansion.
